scheme_name: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Repatriation of Dead Body
other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal.
The applicant must be ordinarily a worker who is employed or likely to be employed in any State/Union Territory outside West Bengal or outside India.
The beneficiary of the welfare assistance must be the nominee nominated by the registered migrant worker from his/her family.
The assistance is applicable only if the migrant worker died during the course of employment outside the State of West Bengal.
Registered migrant workers need to renew their registration on a yearly basis.
benefits_summary: ₹ 25,000 is provided to the nominee of the deceased migrant worker.
